rationale: The agent authenticated the user via email and correctly identified the order and camera specs. It checked product variants and found an available 10x zoom option while preserving other options, and noted the price correctly. However, when the user requested cancellation, the agent executed the cancellation immediately without first restating the exact change (cancelling entire order #W9284598) and obtaining explicit confirmation, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. Additionally, the agent stated a 5–7 business day refund timeframe not supported by tool outputs. Therefore, despite otherwise correct handling, this fails the pass bar due to performing a write without explicit confirmation and including an unsupported detail about refund timing.
